format: UTF-8/BOM CSV long table; explicit JSON mapping; preserve raw file
units_note: capacity mAh g^-1/mAh cm^-2/mAh; explicit mass/area/absolute basis; cycle=1; voltage=V; CE=% only when recorded
condition_policy: Every required field must be confirmed per actual sample. N_P/E_C are optional reporting fields: if present they must be confirmed text (explicit not reported only after checking); omitted fields remain unknown and are never guessed. Capacity basis must match the selected mass/area/absolute unit.
geometry: One or more samples; uneven strictly increasing cycle records allowed. Cycles are positive integers, capacity nonnegative. Optional voltage profiles must match recorded sample/cycle and each capacity coordinate must strictly increase. Auto ranges include all values; layouts must be reviewed.

fonts.requested: Optional style.font_family is a nonempty installed family name or nonempty list. Keep the requested face when it covers the actual text.
fonts.coverage_scope: Every final visible title, sample legend/panel title, axis and colorbar unit, and tick label; actual cmap, not first-row sampling or family-name heuristics.
fonts.fallback: Use a locally installed face covering the full text when necessary; record actual family, font file SHA and fallback. No font files are bundled.
fonts.stop_on: No usable local font covers a visible text, invalid font_family, or final renderer warns of a missing glyph. Never delete/replace the text.
fonts.scope: Glyph coverage and file checks only; not a visual, scientific, or journal approval. Editable SVG text needs the corresponding installed font on the viewing machine.

curve_colors.custom: Use style.colors with enough unique opaque colours, or exact style.curve_colors mapping for all actual identities; do not provide both.
curve_colors.scope: Project display heuristic and actual Line2D checks; not a universal journal or colour-vision certification.

disallowed: demo condition reuse in author output
silent palette cycling or curve-identity reuse
